metadata.title: Carrying Capacity Dashboard: model, data and results behind two papers on Australia's carrying capacity (version submission-1)
metadata.description: Archive of the Carrying Capacity Dashboard at the commit submitted with two papers: one on Australia's carrying capacity by region, 2011 to 2025, and one comparing well-known carrying-capacity methods on common Australian data. It holds the model workbook and its browser evaluator; the frozen releases (2011 and 2025 data; published, corrected and improved methods); the data layers and the pipeline that builds them; the results files from which every table and figure is generated; the figure scripts and figures; the supplementary information; and the claims, literature and sources registers with the briefs and reports that record how each number was checked. Code is MIT; the model workbook, default inputs, 2011 baseline and analysis outputs are CC BY 4.0; source data keep their publishers' licences. Copyrighted source documents are held in a separate private archive and are not included.
